entities.summary: Kan'ichi Kuroda was a self-taught Japanese political philosopher and social theorist, associated with Trotskyism, who was deeply involved in far-left political movements. Nearly blind, Kuroda was affectionately nicknamed "The Blind Prophet" and "KuroKan" by his followers. Kuroda Kan'ichi was a philosophers & thinkers from Tokyo (1927-10-20, Tokyo–2006-06-26). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
